restaurantName: Food Street Fried Kway Teow Mee
address: Chinatown Complex Market & Food Centre, #02-173, 335 Smith Street, 050335, Singapore
bio: Loaded with wok hei, their kway teow mee is ribbon rice noodles, egg noodles, bean sprouts and scrambled egg tossed in a secret sauce. For toppings, choose clams only, or a mix of seafood with fish, squid, shrimps and clams....
pageTitle: Food Street Fried Kway Teow Mee
